name: Turn YouTube videos into LinkedIn carousels with Gemini and Telegram

parameters.content:
## Turn YouTube videos into LinkedIn carousels with Gemini and Telegram

### How it works

Paste any YouTube URL and execute. The workflow extracts the video ID, pulls the full transcript via Supadata, and falls back to the video title and description from the YouTube API when no transcript exists. Gemini converts the content into an 8-slide LinkedIn carousel (hook, insights, CTA), and a validation step repairs malformed JSON in a self-healing loop. A second Gemini pass writes the LinkedIn caption and hashtags, then a virality gate scores the caption from 1 to 10 — anything below 8 is automatically rewritten and re-scored until it passes. The finished package (caption + slide-by-slide copy) is sent to Telegram and email, a cover image is generated for the first slide, and every run is logged to Google Sheets.

### Setup steps

- Replace `videoUrl` in the Set node with any YouTube video URL.
- Add a Supadata API key (free tier) as an HTTP Header Auth credential with header name `x-api-key`.
- Add a YouTube API key as a YouTube credential (only used for the description fallback).
- Add a Google Gemini API key for the Gemini nodes.
- Create a Telegram bot with @BotFather, add the token, and set the chat ID in both Telegram nodes.
- Add SMTP credentials in the Email node and set the recipient address.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`; the `Carousels` sheet needs columns: Date, Video ID, Slide Count, Virality Score, Status.

### Customization

Change the slide count, caption style, virality threshold, image prompt style, destinations (Telegram, email, Slack), or log columns. Works with any language — the carousel language follows the video content.

## Fetch content and fallback

Extracts the video ID, pulls the transcript via Supadata, and falls back to the YouTube API title and description when a transcript is unavailable.

## AI carousel and self-healing validation

Gemini turns the content into an 8-slide carousel. The Code node validates the JSON; malformed output is repaired by a second Gemini call in a feedback loop.

## Virality gate and delivery

Writes the caption, scores it 1-10, rewrites anything below 8 automatically, then delivers the package via Telegram and email, generates a cover image, and logs the run.

parameters.prompt:
=You are a LinkedIn carousel designer. The source is the {{ $json.source }} of YouTube video {{ $json.videoId }}.

Content:
{{ $json.text }}

Create an 8-slide LinkedIn carousel:
- Slide 1: a scroll-stopping hook title.
- Slides 2-7: one insight per slide, ordered for a logical narrative.
- Slide 8: a short recap plus a call-to-action to watch the full video at https://youtu.be/{{ $json.videoId }}

Rules: headline max 8 words, body 1-2 sentences, plus a visual idea per slide.

Return ONLY a raw JSON array, no markdown fences, shaped like:
[{"slide":1,"headline":"...","body":"...","visual":"..."}]

=The text below was supposed to be a raw JSON array of LinkedIn carousel slides shaped like [{"slide":1,"headline":"...","body":"...","visual":"..."}], but it is malformed or incomplete.

Return ONLY the corrected, valid raw JSON array with 8 slides. Keep the content unchanged where possible and reconstruct missing fields sensibly.

Broken output:
{{ $json.raw }}

=Write a LinkedIn post caption for a carousel based on the YouTube video {{ $json.videoId }} (https://youtu.be/{{ $json.videoId }}).

Slide headlines:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.slides.map(s => s.headline)) }}

Requirements: a strong hook first line, 2-3 short lines of value, one call-to-action, and 5 relevant hashtags. Match the language of the slide headlines.

Return ONLY the caption text.
